entries.title: v0.6 is the faction framework release
entries.summary: After stabilizing v0.5, v0.6 centers six asymmetric factions and two Leaders per faction.

entries.title: Military uses Command, Orders, conquest, and momentum
entries.summary: Military identity centers battlefield tempo, repeated pressure, Command, Orders, and running the Gauntlet; the General and Commandant divide offense and defense.

entries.title: Diplomats use Terms, Influence, Proposals, and Peace Treaty
entries.summary: Diplomats bargain through Terms, build Influence, ratify distinct Proposals, and may win through Peace Treaty; sanctions provide coercive leverage.

entries.title: Defer the broad Diplomat overhaul to v0.6.1
entries.summary: Large Terms/Proposal recalibration was deliberately held out of v0.6 and moved into the v0.6.1 overhaul.

entries.title: Financiers use Capital, Treasury, Deeds, and Controlling Interest
entries.summary: Financiers convert territory and cards into Capital, manage Treasury and Deeds, and may win through Controlling Interest; Banker and Executive express finance versus operations.

entries.title: Intelligence uses Intel, Missions, Surveillance, and Special Operation
entries.summary: Intelligence accumulates Intel and Operation Progress through Missions, manipulates hidden information, and may win through a Special Operation; Ranger and Spymaster divide fieldcraft and tempo.

entries.title: Mystics use Rites, Invocation, Transmutation, and Ritual
entries.summary: Mystics pursue public, interruptible Rites that unlock Invocation and Transmutation and may culminate in Ritual victory; Alchemist and Spirit Walker express distinct approaches.

entries.title: Inquisition uses Conviction, Condemnation, Purge, and Purification
entries.summary: Inquisition punishes opposing card loss and Arcane use through Conviction, Condemnation, Purge, and Purification; Grand Inquisitor and Witch Hunter divide judgment and pursuit.

entries.title: Faction alternate victories must remain visible and interactive
entries.summary: Alternate victories should shape play and be disruptable, not become solitaire objectives that ignore the Gauntlet.

entries.title: Engineers and Day/Night remain post-v0.6 modules
entries.summary: Engineer/Overlay specialization and a Day/Night module were parked for v0.7 rather than added to the v0.6 faction framework.
